name: isAgentEvidenceIntegrityVerified
definition: True when every Tracekit evidence bundle received in the evaluation window verified intact against the signer keys Spektrum pinned when the customer connected: Integrity VERIFIED, no failed verifier check, at least one run.
population: Tracekit evidence bundles (.tkb) the customer pushed in the evaluation window, each verified by Integration-Service
evidenceRequiredForTrue: At least one bundle in the window, and every bundle verified intact. A run that never closed, a failed check or an unverifiable bundle is false. Intact is not complete: it does not show that every agent action was captured.

changeLog.change: Registered with the Tracekit agent evidence transforms; proposed, no requirement reads it yet.

notes: Input is Integration-Service's summary of `tracekit verify --json` (tracekit-ai 1.4.2) per bundle (src/services/tracekit_evidence.py), not a vendor API response. The trust config is Spektrum's, never the uploader's. No integration answers this key yet, so no RTA row maps it.
